result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I did not add new tests for the fixed cases, so they are untested. The `codeanalyzer` test suite ran with no failures reported, but I only saw the tail of the output.

- **Generated HTML rules:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered and `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **`<doc>` XML rule:** the path pattern `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so a real `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript rule:** the path pattern `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, so a real `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` is covered by a separate rule that I left alone.

Ordinary `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of these scopes because every rule still needs its content pattern to match. The `<doc>` rule matches a line that is exactly `<doc>`, as before.
